name: preview-access
description: Puts the current work in front of a user who may not be at this machine — works out from the project and the conversation what to look at (preview server, built site, dev server, file, release, PR), finds or starts it the way the project does, proves it is reachable from another device, and hands over direct, named links to what changed. Not tied to any one tool. Reuses the running preview, never hands over an unfetched or localhost-only link, and answers 'give me the URL again' without rebuilding.
